findings.evidence: Call me Ishmael...having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little...It is a way I have of driving off the spleen
Entering that gable-ended Spouter-Inn...Father Mapple rose...commenced the hymn...The ribs and terrors in the whale
He pressed his forehead against mine, clasped me round the waist, and said that henceforth we were married; meaning, in his country's phrase, that we were bosom friends
Going on board the Pequod...Behind the main-mast stood...Captain Peleg...Bildad went on mumbling out of his book...Captain Ahab is all ready
It was quite late when the Moss came to anchor. The Spouter-Inn landlord had recommended us to the Try Pots...A short, cold Christmas...the Pequod thrust her undaunted bows...Starbuck...Stubb...Flask
Starbuck's fortitude...the complete abasement of poor Starbuck's fortitude; the ineffable thing has tied me to him; tows me with a cable I have no knife to cut
Captain Ahab stood upon his quarter-deck...Threading its way out from among his grey hairs...you saw a slender rod-like mark...his bone leg steadied in that hole
'Look ye! d'ye see this Spanish ounce of gold?'—holding up the coin...nailing it to the main-mast...Whosoever of ye raises me a white-headed whale...Starbuck paled, and turned, and shivered
The figure at its bows was tall and swart...his black cotton jacket funereally crowned by a glistening white plaited turban...'All ready there, Fedallah?'
a short rushing sound leaped out of the boat...the whale, merely grazed by the iron, escaped...the boat was swamped...At dawn, a faint creaking...the ship loomed into view

What most puzzled you was a long, limber, portentous, black mass...I offer my own poor endeavors. I promise nothing complete...the great Leviathan is that one creature in the world which must remain unpainted to the last

Such an incantation of reverie lurked in the air...it seemed as if this were the Loom of Time...Queequeg's impulsive, indifferent sword must be chance—aye, chance, free will, and necessity; The Whiteness of the Whale...the whiteness of the whale that above all things appalled me
An Anacharsis Clootz deputation from all the isles of the sea...Ahab's quenchless feud seemed mine...Consider the universal cannibalism of the sea; all whose creatures prey upon each other
a vast pulpy mass, furlongs in length...No face or front did it have; an unearthly, formless apparition...Slowly wading through the meadows of brit, the Pequod held on her way toward Java

the harpoon was hurled...Something went hot and hissing along every wrist. It was the magical line...Stubb slowly churned his long sharp lance into the fish...The monster wallowed in boiling spray; then gush after gush of clotted red gore

'Cook, don't you think this steak is rather overdone?...Go and talk to 'em'...old Fleece leaned over the side...Ahab came alone from his cabin, took Stubb's long spade, and leaning upon it fixed his eyes on that black and hooded head, which seemed the Sphynx's in the desert

the Jeroboam of Nantucket...Gabriel pronounced him the Shaker God incarnated...the Jungfrau, Derick De Deer, master, of Bremen...his complete ignorance of the White Whale...Gliding by the Bashee isles we emerged at last upon the great South Sea

Stubb was true to his word...by the merest chance the ship itself at last rescued him; but from that hour the little negro went about the deck an idiot. The sea had jeeringly kept his finite body up, but drowned the infinite of his soul

By midnight the works were in full operation...the burning ship drove on...Standing at her helm, I was horribly conscious of something fatally wrong...Ahab, renouncing the quadrant: 'the level compass, and dead-reckoning by log and by line—these shall conduct me'
Towards evening the Pequod, bare-poled, fought a Typhoon striking her ahead. Sky and sea roared and split with thunder, and blazed with lightning

All the yard-arms were tipped with a pallid fire...Ahab: 'the white flame but lights the way to the White Whale!'...'Ego non baptizo te in nomine patris, sed in nomine diaboli!'...Starbuck grasped Ahab's arm—'God is against thee, old man; forbear!'

the carpenter made Ahab another leg from the broken keel...Perth was hammering at his anvil when Ahab came along...Pip's cabin shall be Pip's home henceforth...Queequeg...used his coffin for a sea-chest...the lost buoy must be replaced...Queequeg hinted at his coffin...Rig it, carpenter

Ahab knocked the head off the lance, hammered the rod, magnetized the needle...the Pequod thrust her undaunted bows into the opposing wind...next day the Rachel was descried...a little lad of twelve...Ahab: 'I will not do it.'
Fedallah was calmly eyeing the Right Whale's head...in the Parsee Ahab saw his forethrown shadow...'Ere thou couldst die on this voyage, two hearses must be seen by thee'

There she blows!—there she blows! A hump like a snow-hill!...Moby Dick bodily burst into view...Rising with his utmost velocity...the White Whale boomed his entire bulk into the pure element of air...the half torn body of the Parsee was seen; his sable raiment frayed to shreds

'Oh, Ahab,' cried Starbuck, 'not too late is it, even now, the third day, to desist'...Ahab: 'Lower away!'...the carpenter made Ahab another leg...Numbers of sharks rose maliciously snapping at the oars
the solid white buttress of his forehead smote the ship's starboard bow, till men and timbers reeled...The whale dived beneath the settling ship and shot to the surface
the harpoon was darted; the line ran foul. Ahab stooped to clear it; he did clear it; but the flying turn caught him round the neck, and voicelessly...he was shot out of the boat

a red arm and a hammer hovered backwardly uplifted...a sky-hawk...chanced to intercept its broad fluttering wing between the hammer and the wood...the bird of heaven, with archangelic shrieks...went down with his ship

the coffin life-buoy shot lengthwise from the sea, fell over, and floated by my side. Buoyed up by that coffin, for almost one whole day and night, I floated...It was the devious-cruising Rachel, that in her retracing search after her missing children, only found another orphan
What the white whale was to Ahab...the burning ship drove on...like a self-consuming misanthrope, the whale burns by his own body...Ahab's quenchless feud seemed mine
